x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

def absolute(value):
    return -value if value < 0 else value

best_a = 0
best_b = 1
min_diff = 1e15
ratio = x / y

for j in range(1, n + 1):
    left, right = 0, 1000000000
    while right - left > 10:
        m1 = left + (right - left) // 3
        m2 = right - (right - left) // 3
        diff1 = absolute(ratio - m1 / j)
        diff2 = absolute(ratio - m2 / j)
        if diff1 > diff2:
            left = m1
        else:
            right = m2
    for i in range(left, right + 4):
        current_diff = absolute(ratio - i / j)
        if current_diff < min_diff - 1e-15:
            min_diff = current_diff
            best_a = i
            best_b = j

print(f"{best_a}/{best_b}")
